# The Unsolved Mathematics Atlas (`v0.3.0`) — Full LLM Context (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical agent rules: `AGENTS.md`. Concise index: `llms.txt`.
> Author: Alexander S. Donahue (ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, independent researcher).
> Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-mathematics
> Licenses: CC BY 4.0 (content, `LICENSE`) · MIT (code, `LICENSE-CODE`).

## 1. Mission & Epistemic Contract

`unsolved-mathematics` is a version-controlled, machine-readable research atlas of **106 open mathematical problems** paired with:
1. A **single-source YAML registry** (`data/problems.yaml`, validated strictly against `schema/problem.schema.json`).
2. **106 structured 7-section dossiers** (`problems/<slug>/{README,history,originator,approaches,attempts,papers,mathematicians,status}.md`) plus 106 AI-assisted working syntheses (`meta-analyses/<slug>.md`).
3. A **deterministic BM25 retrieval corpus** (`rag/corpus.jsonl`, 3,763 unique chunks, zero optional tokenizer drift).
4. A **primary-source citation verification audit** (`scripts/verify_citations.py` + `data/citation-verification-log.json`): 554 identifier-bearing rows checked live against `export.arxiv.org` and `api.crossref.org` (`network_error: 0`), yielding **445 API-verified identifiers** and **109 invalid/hallucinated identifiers stripped** honestly to `—` / `needs-verification`.
5. A **standalone, zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formal core** (`formal/`) proving **14 headline structural lemmas, finite cases, and barrier meta-theorems** across 4 open problems (Collatz 8, Erdős–Straus 1, Lonely Runner 3, Brocard 2) with **0 `sorry`, 0 `admit`, 0 `native_decide`, 0 custom `axiom`**, concrete non-vacuity witnesses (`formal/NonVacuity.lean`), axiom audit (`formal/VerifyAxioms.lean` strictly within `{propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}`), challenge/solution comparator (`formal/Challenge.lean`, `formal/comparator.json`), and human-auditable statement fidelity (`formal/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md`).

**Hard Epistemic Invariants:**
- Never claim any open conjecture is solved without primary-source mathematical consensus.
- Never fabricate a DOI, arXiv ID, metric, test result, or review record.
- Never cite `0thernes LLC` (no legal entity exists as of November 2026); use `Alexander S. Donahue` (independent researcher, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`).
- Disclose transparently that only 1/4 planned AI model passes (Claude self-review) and 0/106 independent human mathematician peer reviews have been completed.
- Commit and push cleanly straight to `main` (Build Standard R2; no PR templates per R4).

## 2. Canonical Directory Map

- `VERSION` — single version source (`0.3.0`)
- `data/problems.yaml` — sole source of truth for the 106 problems
- `data/schema.json` — mandatory JSON Schema enforced by `scripts/validate.py`
- `data/problems.json` — deterministically generated machine registry (`CURRENT_YEAR = 2026`, tie-break `(-css, slug)`)
- `data/citation-verification-log.json` — full API verification log for all 552 checked identifiers
- `data/MANIFEST.sha256` — SHA-256 tamper-evidence manifest (`scripts/build_data_manifest.py --check`)
- `formal/` — standalone Lean 4.35.0 formal core (`FormalAtlas/{Defs,Collatz,ErdosStraus,LonelyRunner,Brocard}.lean`, `Challenge.lean`, `Solution.lean`, `NonVacuity.lean`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`, `comparator.json`, `STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md`)
- `scripts/` — `generate.py`, `validate.py`, `check_dossiers.py`, `check_papers.py`, `proof_claim_sweep.py`, `verify_citations.py`, `build_indexes.py`, `build_review_register.py`, `build_data_manifest.py`
- `rag/` — `build_corpus.py`, `retriever.py`, `corpus.jsonl`
- `tests/` — `test_atlas.py`, `test_collatz_instruments.py`, `test_verification_ladder.py`, `test_properties.py`, `mutation_check.py`
- `CLAIMS.md` — falsifiable claims ledger ("What would prove us wrong")
- `LIMITATIONS.md` — explicit scope, review, formalization, and selection-bias boundaries
- `REPLICATION.md` — clean-clone reproduction commands and replication log
- `docs/reviews/2026-11-23-forensic-philosophical-audit.md` — exhaustive 6-class taxonomy + 5W1H + Deductive/Inductive/Abductive & Philosophy of Mathematics audit + 10-pass review log
- `docs/adr/0001–0003` — Architecture Decision Records

## 3. Verification Commands

```bash
python scripts/generate.py --check
python scripts/validate.py
python scripts/check_dossiers.py
python scripts/check_papers.py
python scripts/proof_claim_sweep.py
python scripts/build_data_manifest.py --check
python -m pytest -v tests/
python tests/mutation_check.py
cd formal && lake build Challenge Solution NonVacuity && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
# Linux CI with bubblewrap:
cd formal && lake check --paranoid && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```
